fusions.name: Colours Raised
fusions.desc: A blow that deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Hood and Gag
fusions.desc: Throws a weighted cloth that deals 11 damage to the first enemy it meets, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Suppressed] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Quiet Hangings
fusions.desc: Veils you and your allies for 6 seconds. Enemies take 60% longer to notice you, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Robes of State
fusions.desc: Conjures robes of office: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 8%, your arcane resistance rises by 8%, and 5% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.
